subject: Data terms: DPA redlines, SCCs & order form handoff
body:
From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@quantummed.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantummed.ai, legal@quantummed.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: DPA + SCCs questions before finalizing order form

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency and dedup features.
We routed the commercial draft to legal/procurement and they flagged a few items we need to resolve before we can issue a PO:

- QuantumMed needs clarity on controller/processor roles for the new telemetry exports (section 3).
- We require a transfer-impact addendum (EU patient records) with explicit SCCs mapping.
- A couple of standard DPA redlines: subprocessor notification window and audit evidence (SOC2 + export controls).

Can you share a proposed path and timeline for redlines + any evidence we can attach to our procurement packet?

Attached: initial Order Form (commercial team redline).

Best,
Lisa Gomez
Head of Legal Operations
QuantumMed
---

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@quantummed.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs questions before finalizing order form

Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and the redline. Quick proposal to keep timelines tight:

1) We’ll triage the redlines today and return a marked DPA (track changes) by Friday EOD (US).
2) Privacy team (Irene) will provide an SCCs mapping + short transfer-impact memo by Monday.
3) Commercial (Ben) will prepare a clean order form reflecting any fee adjustments tied to export controls and retention.
4) We’ll include SOC2 artifact draw (scope) and a short checklist for procurement to attach to the PO packet.

Can you confirm your target signature date? If you need a PO before the DPA is final, we can provide an interim mutual action plan to support procurement.

Irene/Ben/Laura — looping you in to confirm the timeline and owners below.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference


From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@quantummed.ai>, procurement@quantummed.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs questions before finalizing order form

Aisha — I reviewed the commercial redline. Main commercial asks to note:

- QuantumMed requested a 6-month data retention carveout for anonymized telemetry (we can accept but need to confirm volume/price impact).
- They asked for a 10% credit if performance SLA misses exceed 3 incidents in a quarter (we should avoid an unconditional credit — propose service credits cap).

Attaching a one-page order form redline snapshot. Planning to sync with Laura on packaging.

-Ben
Account Director, Redwood Inference

Attachment: QuantumMed_OrderForm_Redline_20260812.pdf


From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@quantummed.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs questions before finalizing order form

Thanks Lisa — I pulled the DPA and the order form. High level privacy notes and evidence deliverables below (so procurement has everything):

Privacy / DPA items (proposed positions)
- Roles: Redwood will be a processor for customer data under the Order Form. We accept limited joint controller language only for telemetry-derived anonymous metrics; we will not accept joint controller for patient PHI.
- SCCs: we will provide the standard EU SCCs addendum + an explicit mapping for each data category in the DPA. I’ll attach a templated SCCs document.
- Subprocessors: we require 30-day prior notice for new subprocessors; we can negotiate a shorter notice for critical infra changes (15 days) with a defined exception process.
- Audit & evidence: we can provide SOC2 Type II scope statement and secure extracts of TLS/at-rest encryption configuration. Full SOC2 report available under NDA (procurement usually accepts scope + attestation).

Open questions for QuantumMed procurement
- Which EU jurisdictions have patient data? Need country list to finalize SCCs/transfer impact logic.
- Is there a legal requirement for onshore processing for any dataset?

Timeline
- I’ll deliver SCCs-template.docx and the transfer-impact workbook (DPA_transfer-impact.xlsx) by Monday, 17 Aug EOD.

Attachment: SCCs-template.docx; DPA_transfer-impact.xlsx

Regards,
Irene Choi
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference


From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@quantummed.ai>, procurement@quantummed.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs questions before finalizing order form

Thanks everyone — quick summary and ask so we have an MAM (mutual action plan) for procurement: 

Action items (Redwood owners)
- Aisha: coordinate final DPA redline; send clean order form for signature (target: 2026-08-20).
- Irene: deliver SCCs mapping + transfer-impact workbook (delivered 2026-08-16).
- Ben/Laura: final commercial clean copy and confirmation on retention carveout pricing (in progress).

Requests for QuantumMed procurement
- Please confirm the list of EU countries that will contain patient records (reply to this thread).
- Indicate whether your procurement team can proceed with a PO on condition of final DPA execution, or if you require a fully executed DPA before PO issuance.

If you confirm PO-first path, we’ll provide:
- Mutual Action Plan (MAM) with milestones and signoff owners
- SOC2 scope statement and attestation stub for procurement packet

Lisa — happy to hop on a 20-min call to align timeline if that helps.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0129
E: aisha.rahman@redwood.com
